title: Slashes
content:

When necessary, differentiate between a slash for URLs and a backslash for servers and folders.

When you instruct customers to enter a slash, always include the spelled-out term (backslash or slash) first, followed by the symbol in parentheses.Example Enter two backslashes (\\) ....

See alsoNumbersSpecial character term collectionURLs and web addresses

To imply a combination. Capitalize the word after the slash if the word before the slash is capitalized. For example, if country/region is used as a label in a form, capitalize it as Country/Region.Examplesclient/serverTCP/IPCD/DVD driveUse the on/off switch to turn your mouse off when you're not using it.Turn on the On/Off toggle.

To separate parts of an internet address. Use two slashes after the protocol name. Example ftp://example.com/downloads

In server, folder, and file names.Example \\mslibrary\catalog\collect.doc

Between the numerator and denominator of fractions in equations that occur in text.Examplesa/x + b/y = 1x + 2/3(y) = m

Don't use a slash as a substitute for or, like product/service. If the UI uses a slash in this way, follow the interface in describing the label, but use or to describe the action in text. ExamplesSelect Automatic trapping to add or remove a check mark.To turn the purchasing workflow on or off ....

Exception It's OK to use country/region and ZIP Code/postal code where space is limited.

See alsoand/orcountry or regioneither/or
